title: Playbooks team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/playbooks.yaml: the team layer of the playbooks plugin's settings. A value here overrides the same key in the plugin's userConfig. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

described_problem.description: What the fable-5 playbook does when the user describes a problem without asking for a change. report: assess, report and offer the fix. fix: make the change and present the result; questions and thinking out loud stay assessments, and destructive or outward-visible steps still wait for consent.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it; no userConfig option. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example fable-5); an entry beats this file's verification value.
